objective: Train (OpenAI-ES, curriculum rand n = 200/400/800) an agent that attends to one violated not-all-equal knot, flips one of its distinctions and chooses the next knot to attend to, with and without memory of earlier steps (L1, L2w, L2, L3); test on unseen planted instances at rand n = 200, 800, 3200 (primary) and 12800, and local n = 200, 800, 3200; compare flips, incidences and CPU per instance with WalkSAT, probSAT, Novelty+, greedy-where, sticky and focused Metropolis (training-tuned and re-tuned per cell), a random agent, and CaDiCaL as context; training charged through the break-even count. Stop at the frozen decision rule. (Objective restated 2026-11-16 to the frozen design; the planning text named n = 100 and a stress size of 1600.)
status: Clean loss by the frozen rule (refereed: confirmed with fixes, no Block): the learned where-and-what agent with memory took 0.45 and 0.60 times the flips of re-tuned Novelty+ at its training sizes by the frozen protocol (referee: about 0.71 and 0.77 on five-run estimates), but R = 1.07 [0.90, 1.21] at n = 3200 (primary; 1.10 [1.02, 1.19] on better estimates), 2.43 at 12800, 2.6-55 on the unseen local pattern; memory helps on the primary cell (M = 0.37); 4-8 times CPU per flip, no marginal-cost win. Obstruction for memory reads counted in steps, trained at n <= 800.
title: Learned where-next agent with memory against plain search and tuned local heuristics on planted not-all-equal knot patterns
